Name: lamplight12347's Working Goose for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Permissions are open for both this and the [i]original [/i]original, so I present lamplight12347's Working Goose (found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7040]here[/url]) for SDV 1.6. Artwork for geese and eggs by Luzze42 (original found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5888]here[/url]).

This mod adds 3 varieties of geese: white, wild, and gold. They live in﻿ coops and produce down and eggs that can be turned into mayonnaise

Credits go to Luzze42 and lamplight12347 for the original mods

Enjoy!
